Ollama provider sends the chat to /api/chat and maps the native reply, including token counts and finish reason

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var reqJson = "{\"extra_body\":{\"num_ctx\":512,\"repeat_penalty\":1.1,\"top_k\":5},\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"ollama/qwen2:0.5b\"}";
        var req = JsonUtil.fromJson(reqJson, ChatCompletionRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.chat(req);
        System.out.println(result.choices());
        System.out.println(result.choices().get(0).message().content());
        System.out.println(result.choices().get(0).finishReason());
        System.out.println(result.model());
        System.out.println(result.usage().promptTokens());
        System.out.println(result.usage().completionTokens());
        System.out.println(result.usage().totalTokens());
        }
    }
}
```
